players.name: Raul Jimenez
players.note: Sealed the 2-0 with a close-range header in the 67th minute, converting a Roberto Alvarado cross after a sustained spell of pressure.

players.name: Julian Quinones
players.note: Opened the scoring in the 9th minute with a clinical first-time finish from inside the box, assisted by Erik Lira.

players.name: Roberto Alvarado
players.note: Provided the assist for Mexico's second goal and was a constant outlet down the right, finishing with 4/12 crosses completed.

players.name: Oh Hyeon-Gyu
players.note: Scored the 80th-minute winner moments after coming off the bench, finishing from close range off a Hwang In-Beom assist.

players.name: Hwang In-Beom
players.note: Equalized in the 67th minute from a Lee Kang-In assist, then turned provider for the winning goal 13 minutes later.

players.name: Ladislav Krejci
players.note: Headed Czechia into a surprise lead in the 56th minute from a Vladimir Coufal cross, briefly putting the pre-match favorite behind.

players.name: Jovo Lukic
players.note: Opened the scoring for the visitors in the 21st minute with a close-range header off a Sead Kolasinac corner, giving Bosnia an early lead despite Canada's territorial control.

players.name: Cyle Larin
players.note: Came off the bench in the 76th minute and struck the equalizer two minutes later, finishing from the center of the box on a Promise David assist to salvage a point for the hosts.

players.name: Promise David
players.note: Made an immediate impact off the bench, setting up Cyle Larin's 78th-minute equalizer on a swift counter-attack before narrowly missing a chance of his own moments later.
